values.event_label: Specifies the serialisation position of the new fields: block body becomes RLP([transactions, ommers, withdrawals]) and block RLP becomes RLP([header, transactions, ommers, withdrawals]); adds a dedicated 'New field in the execution block header: withdrawals root' section with the full 16-element header RLP list ending in `withdrawals_root`; adds two NOTEs referring to EIP-3675 for the fixed ommers value and other fixed header values; drops the TODO about logs and receipts; expands the rationale on operations vs transactions and on the block-footprint bound (~1% of average block size).
values.rationale: Defines the concrete block-body and block-header encodings that clients must implement, and removes an unresolved specification TODO.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit b4b1218d08: Update EIP-4895 (#4957)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.event_label: Removes the nested RLP encoding of withdrawals: `Withdrawal` objects are now serialised as an RLP list with the schema `[index, address, amount]` rather than `RLP([index, address, amount])`, and the worked example uses plain lists; also fixes the 'dataa' typo.
values.rationale: Changes the wire encoding of every withdrawal and therefore the withdrawals_root computation; a consensus-relevant serialisation change.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit cadc592864: Update EIP-4895: do not nest RLP encoding (#4965)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.event_label: Repo-wide sweep pointing the copyright waiver at the in-repo LICENSE file (PR #5055).
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 9e393a79d9: Force usage of included LICENSE file (#5055)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.event_label: Editing pass (PR #5697) that re-frames the whole specification from 'block' to 'execution payload' terminology and corrects the header RLP illustration: the fixed ommers hash constant, difficulty 0 and the zero nonce are inlined, `bloom`/`time`/`mix_hash` are renamed to `logs_bloom`/`timestamp`/`prev_randao`, and the previously missing `base_fee_per_gas` field is added before `withdrawals_root`; the 'Commitment to withdrawals' and 'New field in the header' sections are merged; the note now cites EIP-3675 and EIP-4399; state-transition wording changes from 'should increase' to 'increases'; the `index` is described as uniquely identifying each withdrawal.
values.rationale: Corrects the illustrated header field list (adding base_fee_per_gas) and firms up normative wording; the header layout is consensus-critical.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 85f10e690d: editing pass, apply feedback from other sources (#5697)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.event_label: Adds a fourth field to the Withdrawal object: the consensus-layer `validator_index`. The schema becomes `[index, validator_index, address, amount]`, examples are updated, and the `index` is documented as a global counter starting at 0 and incrementing by 1 per withdrawal. Also introduces the 'compuggational' typo in the rationale.
values.rationale: Adds a field to the serialised withdrawal structure and pins down index semantics.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 773f0248ef: update EIP with `validator_index` and more info around `index` (#5835)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.event_label: Status Draft -> Review (PR #5822) and removal of the two comparative EIP references from the Motivation: '[EIP-4863](./eip-4863.md)' becomes 'the prior approach introducing a new transaction type' and the '[EIP-4788](./eip-4788.md) + user-space withdrawal contract' example is dropped.
values.rationale: Process-status change plus removal of informative comparative references; no normative behaviour, parameter or encoding changes. Recorded as change_type dependency because the substantive part of the diff is the removal of two explicit cross-EIP references (see dependency_history).
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 4e83ad5184: Update EIP-4895: update status to review (#5822)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.rationale: Spelling-only change reverting the typo introduced by commit 773f0248.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit e3eb747282: Update EIP-4895: fix small typo (#6029)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.event_label: Clarifies withdrawal field types and allowed values (PR #6089): `validator_index` is typed as a `uint64`, and `amount` changes from 'an amount of ether given in wei as a 256-bit value' to 'a nonzero amount of ether given in wei as a uint64 value'.
values.rationale: Changes the declared width of the amount field and adds a nonzero constraint; directly affects encoding and validation.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 6d0e7420ba: clarify types and allowed values for withdrawal data (#6089)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.event_label: Corrects the amount type introduced ~1.5 hours earlier: `uint64` -> `uint256` (PR #6090, described in its subject as fixing a typo from PR #6089).
values.rationale: Reverses the width change of the previous commit; same logical update.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 0fa80ec535: fix typo from #6089 to use correct type for withdrawal `amount` (#6090)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.event_label: CL-EL withdrawals harmonisation (PR #6325): `amount` becomes 'a nonzero amount of ether given in Gwei (1e9 wei) as a uint64 value', and the State transition section gains an explicit reminder that the amount is in Gwei and must be converted to wei when updating account balances.
values.rationale: Changes both the unit and the width of the amount field and adds a conversion requirement to the state transition; a consensus-critical change affecting both layers.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit b56a299fba: EIP-4895: CL-EL withdrawals harmonization: using units of Gwei (#6325)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.rationale: On ACD 131 (2022-02-04) beacon-chain withdrawals were raised as a top Shanghai priority before any EIP existed ("once we have a beacon chain withdrawal eip we can discuss that in more detail"). This is recorded as the proposal event for the feature that became EIP-4895 (frontmatter created 2022-03-10); the normalization notes that no EIP number existed at the time, so the event attaches to the fork-EIP relationship retrospectively by feature identity, not by number.
values.raw_label: "probably the other biggest one is withdrawal the beacon chain which does not have an eip yet" (ACD 131 Shanghai prioritization discussion)
values.source_title: All Core Devs Meeting 131 notes/transcript (2022-02-04)

values.eip_label: EIP-4895 · Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations
values.rationale: ACD 134 (2022-03-18) compared the two withdrawal designs (transaction-type EIP-4863 vs operations-based EIP-4895), settled on EIP-4895, and its decisions table records "EIP-4895 move to CFI" (item 134.3). The execution-specs commit authored the same day ("Add EIP 4895", body "Agreed in ACD134", merged via PR #477 on 2022-03-23) added it to "EIPs Considered for Inclusion". The historical CFI term maps directly to considered_for_inclusion; occurred_at uses the decision/commit-author date.
values.raw_label: Decision 134.3 "EIP-4895 move to CFI"; added to "EIPs Considered for Inclusion" ("Agreed in ACD134")
values.source_title: Ethereum Core Devs Meeting 134 notes (2022-03-18)
